judging.band.fair.name: Fair
judging.band.fair.description: Off flavors/aromas or major style deficiencies. Unpleasant.
judging.band.problematic.name: Problematic
judging.band.problematic.description: Major off flavors and aromas dominate. Hard to drink.

descriptor.acetaldehyde.name: Acetaldehyde
descriptor.alcoholic.name: Alcoholic
descriptor.alcoholic.description: Aroma, flavor, and warming effect of ethanol and higher alcohols. Sometimes described as hot.
descriptor.astringent.name: Astringent
descriptor.astringent.description: Puckering, lingering harshness and/or dryness in the finish; harsh graininess; huskiness.
descriptor.diacetyl.name: Diacetyl
descriptor.diacetyl.description: Artificial butter, butterscotch, or toffee aroma and flavor. Sometimes perceived as a slickness on the tongue.
descriptor.dms.name: DMS
descriptor.dms.description: At low levels a sweet, cooked or canned corn-like aroma and flavor.
descriptor.estery.name: Estery
descriptor.estery.description: Aroma and/or flavor of any ester (fruits, fruit flavorings, or roses).
descriptor.grassy.name: Grassy
descriptor.grassy.description: Aroma/flavor of fresh-cut grass or green leaves.
descriptor.light_struck.name: Light-Struck
descriptor.light_struck.description: Similar to the aroma of a skunk.
descriptor.metallic.name: Metallic
descriptor.metallic.description: Tinny, coiny, copper, iron, or blood-like flavor.
descriptor.musty.name: Musty
descriptor.oxidized.name: Oxidized
descriptor.oxidized.description: Stale, winy/vinous, cardboard, papery, or sherry-like aromas and flavors.
descriptor.phenolic.name: Phenolic
descriptor.phenolic.description: Spicy (clove, pepper), smoky, plastic, or medicinal aromas/flavors.
descriptor.solvent.name: Solvent
descriptor.solvent.description: Aromas and flavors of higher alcohols (fusel alcohols). Similar to acetone or lacquer thinner.
descriptor.sour_acidic.name: Sour/Acidic
descriptor.sour_acidic.description: Tartness in aroma and flavor. Can be sharp and clean (lactic), or vinegar-like (acetic).
descriptor.sulfur.name: Sulfur
descriptor.sulfur.description: The aroma of rotten eggs or burning matches.
descriptor.vegetal.name: Vegetal
descriptor.vegetal.description: Cooked, canned, or rotten vegetable aroma and flavor (cabbage, onion, celery, asparagus, etc.)
descriptor.yeasty.name: Yeasty
descriptor.yeasty.description: A bready, sulfury or yeast-like aroma or flavor.
